how: We read the website of every Denver wedding planner listed on Lazo (84 listings, 67 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a caterer, a wedding livestreaming service, and a national franchise's Denver page. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: If my venue is in the foothills or mountains, how do you handle shuttles, lodging and the storm or snow fallback? Mountain venues can see snow into May and again from October.
Full planning, partial, or day-of only? Ask what each tier includes in hours and meetings, and who is actually on site that day.
Which Denver and Boulder venues and vendors have you worked with this year? Local relationships are the job.

picks.name: Blue Linden Weddings & Events
picks.blurb: Wanda Bonner started Blue Linden in 2013 and still runs it, with packages that run from wedding management to partial planning to full planning and design. Clients describe her as responsive and genuine, and the site explains what a planner takes off your plate without taking away your input. Denver-based.

picks.name: Right as Rayne Events
picks.blurb: Kinsey and Quincy have known each other 14 years and have run Right as Rayne together since 2017, pairing Kinsey's creativity and design skills with Quincy's eye for detail. Customizable packages from coordination to full planning, serving Denver, Boulder, Estes Park, Vail and Colorado Springs, and already booking 2027.

picks.name: Calluna Events
picks.blurb: Calluna Events has planned and designed elevated weddings across the Mountain West and beyond since 2004, from Boulder. A nationally recognized firm with a refined aesthetic and a high-touch, collaborative approach, for couples who want the event composed to feel like them.

picks.name: Brindle + Oak
picks.blurb: Established in 2014, Brindle + Oak is a Denver wedding planning, design and production firm that customizes its services after a consultation rather than selling fixed tiers. The pitch is the couple's own enjoyment of the engagement and the day, not just the logistics.

picks.name: A Touch of Bliss | Day of Wedding Coordinator
picks.blurb: Day-of coordination is the specialty: A Touch of Bliss says its team has worked more than 1,500 weddings and sells itself as the best friend who is also a logistics master and is not a guest at your wedding. Denver-based, with planning help available too.

picks.name: Sweetly Paired Weddings & Travel
picks.blurb: Lilli Black and Jade Belanger plan weddings in Denver, Boulder, Vail, Beaver Creek, Aspen and Breckenridge plus Mexico destination weddings, with Indian weddings in the portfolio. Sweetly Paired also runs a wedding travel agency for room blocks and guest travel.

picks.name: Aspen & Ivy Events and Travel (formerly Pink Diamond Events)
picks.blurb: Aspen & Ivy, formerly Pink Diamond Events, designs, plans and coordinates single and multi-day weddings in Estes Park, Vail, Aspen, Beaver Creek and abroad from Fort Collins. The team positions itself as a buffer between you and the stressors of planning.

picks.name: Après Vous Events
picks.blurb: Apres Vous Events is a full-service wedding planning, coordination and design company based in Denver and Vail, named for the French phrase meaning after you. The approach is rooted in hospitality, for weddings and milestone celebrations across Colorado.

picks.name: Table 6 Productions | Wedding Planner Colorado
picks.blurb: Heather and Shannon lead Table 6 Productions, a luxury planning and design company creating weddings in Denver, Aspen, Vail and Beaver Creek as well as Florida and destinations worldwide. Heather brings the creative vision and Shannon the execution, with a team of planners behind them.

picks.name: Rocky Mountain Wed
picks.blurb: Melanie Rendleman left the corporate world in 2014 after more than 15 years as a corporate event planner to start Rocky Mountain Wed in Winter Park. She works one-on-one with couples dreaming of a Colorado mountain wedding, with a particular understanding of destination weddings.

picks.name: Carver Coordination
picks.blurb: Stress-free wedding planning and design in Colorado and Wyoming, from Windsor, covering northern Colorado, Grand County and Estes Park. Carver Coordination promises rockstar vendor recommendations and a wedding that is fun first, for all couples.

picks.name: Cloud 9 Weddings & Papers
picks.blurb: Brittany has planned events since 2011, starting in hospitality and non-profit galas before weddings became the focus. Cloud 9 pairs planning with its own wedding invitations and papers, and the site links to videos of its Colorado weddings.
